info.title: OdHive API
info.description: Local API of OdHive, used by its web UI and CLI. Every request needs the session cookie `odhive_session` (set by `/login`) or `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, else 401. Every request other than GET/HEAD must also carry the header `X-OdHive: 1` and, from a browser, OdHive's own `Origin` (403 `forbidden_origin`; a request without `Origin` needs the bearer token). Bodies over 1 MiB get 413 `body_too_large`; a request not answered within 60 s gets 503 `timeout`. No CORS headers are ever sent.

get.summary:
Checks PostgreSQL (reachable over the default connection, server
version, role may create databases), Python for each registered
Community source (Odoo 19 and 20 when none is registered), wkhtmltopdf,
git and uv. Each check carries a fix when something is off; install
commands are text for the user and are never run.

outside this service. CPU use is measured since the previous call (0 on
the first); calls less than a second apart get the same sample.
Running and recently ended jobs, oldest first.

post.summary:
Cancels a running job: its tool is stopped and what it did is undone.
Answers once the job ended (or after 20 s); an ended job is returned as
is.

put.summary:
Replaces the project's `odoo.conf` options and writes `odoo.conf`
(mode `0600`) the way the next start will. Values are checked against
the project's option schema; options it does not know (read by
third-party modules) are accepted. Running instances keep the old
options until they restart. Refused while the project is being set up.

409.description: A setup of the project runs

422.description: Invalid option: bad key or value, a managed or command-line only option, a secret outside secrets

post.summary:
Reads an existing `odoo.conf` into options the form can save. Ports,
database and workers belong to instances, addons paths and other
sections to the project; they are reported, not imported.

422.description: Not an odoo.conf: syntax error or no [options] section

post.summary:
Renders `odoo.conf` for options not saved yet (checked like a save),
next to the saved file. Secret values are masked; nothing is written.

422.description: Invalid option, as for a save

404.description: No such project, or the secret has no saved value

422.description: The key is not a secret

get.summary:
Connects with the project's `db_host`, `db_port`, `db_user`,
`db_password` and `db_sslmode` (unset ones come from the project's
`[env]` `PG*` variables, then the service's, then libpq's defaults) and
reports whether the server is reachable, its version against the
project's Odoo series, and whether the role may create databases. The
password is used to log in and is never part of the answer.

The `odoo.conf` options of the project's Odoo, read with the project's
Python (cached per source tree); the bundled list while it has no venv.

post.summary:
Starts setting up the project's Python environment: creates `.venv`
(kept when it exists, unless `recreate`) and installs the requirements
of Odoo and of the project's modules. Follow it with `/jobs/{id}` or the
WebSocket. Refused while an instance of the project runs.

409.description: An instance runs or a setup runs

get.summary:
Finds and probes the Python 3 interpreters on `PATH` and those uv
installed. With `source`, each is judged against that Odoo's range.

post.summary:
